description: Shared by every accessware crate, which extends it with github>accessware/.github. Everything comes in one PR a week, since the nightly pinned for rustfmt changes every day and only has to follow Paperback's, which moves on Mondays. Renovate merges a PR itself once every check on it has passed, rather than through GitHub's auto-merge, which with no required checks could merge before CI ran.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Renovate never groups lock file maintenance with other updates, so it comes as its own PR, on the same day.

packageRules.description: Raise the requirement in Cargo.toml too, so a crate asks for the version it's tested with.
